title: Drosophila Genomic DNA Isolation Using NEB Monarch Kit
author: David Loehlin

steps.title: Pre‑heat block and elution buffer
steps.instruction: Set a heat block (or shaking block) to 56 °C. Pre‑warm the required volume of gDNA Elution Buffer in the block – at least (k + 1) × 100 µL for k samples.

steps.title: Add EDTA to tubes
steps.instruction: Pipet 20 µL of 0.5 M EDTA into the bottom of each 1.5 mL tube, label the tubes, and place them on ice.

steps.title: Add anesthetized flies
steps.instruction: Anaesthetize flies (e.g., with CO₂) and sweep the desired number into each tube on ice: 1–5 flies for PCR or 10–20 mg of flies for Southern blot.

steps.title: Grind flies
steps.instruction: Using a clean micro‑tube pestle, crush the flies against the conical sidewall (keep them off the tube bottom) with 5–40 twists until all major parts are fragmented. If a fly sticks to the bottom, use the pestle as a piston or a pipette tip to retrieve the material.

steps.title: Add TLBK master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a TLBK master mix of 10 µL Proteinase K (stored at –20 °C) plus 180 µL Tissue Lysis Buffer per sample. Add 190 µL of this mix to each ground tissue, then vortex immediately and thoroughly to release any material stuck to the tube bottom.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes in a 56 °C heat block for 30 min to 3 h, vortexing every 5–15 min (or place in a shaking block at ~1400 RPM). Proceed to grind the next sample while the previous one incubates.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge the tubes for 3 min at maximum speed. Transfer the cleared supernatants to new 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase A to each lysate, vortex briefly, then incubate 5 min at 56 °C.

steps.title: Add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL gDNA Binding Buffer to each sample and mix thoroughly by pulse‑vortexing for 5–10 seconds.

steps.title: Load lysate onto columns
steps.instruction: Insert a gDNA column into a collection tube (one column per sample, labeled). Pipet the binding‑buffer‑mixed lysate onto the column matrix without touching the upper column area.

steps.title: Centrifuge columns (first spin)
steps.instruction: Cap the collection tubes and centrifuge for 3 min at 1,000 g.

steps.title: Centrifuge columns (second spin)
steps.instruction: Cap again and centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Transfer column and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Move the column to a clean collection tube. If the column contacts the flow‑through, re‑spin. Pour the flow‑through into liquid waste and discard the original collection tube.

steps.title: First wash with Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL gDNA Wash Buffer to each column, cap, and invert the tube so the buffer reaches the cap.

steps.title: Centrifuge first wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Second wash with Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Pipet the flow‑through into liquid waste (a dirty tip may be reused or a vacuum aspirator can be used), then re‑insert the column into the collection tube, add another 500 µL Wash Buffer, cap, and centrifuge for 2 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Transfer column to clean tube
steps.instruction: Move each column to a clean 1.5 mL tube, taking care not to bend the tube caps.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Using a clean filter tip, add 100 µL of warm Elution Buffer directly to the column matrix (for Southern blot use 35 µL). Incubate at room temperature for at least 1 minute.

steps.title: Collect eluate and store DNA
steps.instruction: Load the centrifuge with the 1.5 mL tubes and columns so that tube caps trail the direction of rotation. Cap the rotor lid and centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed. Discard the column, cap the tubes, label them, and store the purified gDNA at –20 °C.
